product.name: Velara ShieldPro 2000 Goggles
product.description: The Velara ShieldPro 2000 Goggles provide reliable eye protection for laboratory environments. Constructed from impact‑resistant polycarbonate lenses and a flexible rubber seal, they deliver clear vision and a comfortable fit for extended use. The ergonomic frame accommodates a wide range of head sizes, while the anti‑fog coating reduces condensation during temperature fluctuations. Designed for universal compatibility with standard lab workstations, the goggles meet basic safety standards for chemical splash and particulate exposure. Their lightweight construction and durable materials make them suitable for routine use in research, teaching, and industrial settings.
